@graph.name: Help Scout
@graph.description: Customer support software for shared inbox conversations, a hosted knowledge base and website messaging.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Free plan lists up to five users, one inbox, one Docs site and 100 contacts per month. Check the article, tag and saved-reply allowances before using it for a busy support address.

mainEntity.name: What is Help Scout best for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Help Scout suits teams that want a shared inbox, Docs and customer context in one support workspace. It is less suitable when the main need is a large ticket taxonomy or a self-hosted knowledge base.

mainEntity.name: Does Help Scout include an AI agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: The pricing page lists Envoy at US$0.75 per resolution. AI Inbox assistance and drafting features vary by plan. Confirm the current product label and resolution definition before estimating usage.
